_comment: THE CANONICAL action-only CASES, read by BOTH modules' tests.
oasgen-provider decides this shape at generation time (oas2jsonschema.isActionOnly, issues
625 and 629); rest-dynamic-controller decides it at runtime (controllers.isActionOnlyResource).
They cannot share code -- separate Go modules, and both predicates live under internal/ -- so
they share THIS FILE instead. Each module's test reads it and asserts its own predicate against
That is the enforceable version of 'one predicate'. A comment saying 'keep these in sync' is
not: it fails silently, and the whole argument for one predicate is that a suppression and its
inverse must not disagree about the shape. If you change one predicate, a row here fails in the
Each escape exists because it makes the create reachable WITHOUT a non-matching findby. The
runtime queues a Create only on !ResourceExists, so for a kind with no other write verb the
create is reachable exactly one way -- unless one of these escapes applies.

cases.name: the canonical shape: findby plus create, nothing else
cases.why: openstack-ironic-operator-kog's ironic-node-provision, verbatim from its manifest: create is PUT /v1/nodes/{node_id}/states/provision, an ACTION rather than a creation

cases.name: create alone, no findby
cases.why: still action-only by shape; whether anything can make its create unreachable is the matchability question, not this one

cases.name: a get verb
cases.why: Observe no longer decides existence from findby alone

cases.name: an update verb
cases.why: drift can drive a write, so a matching findby does not make the kind inert

cases.name: a dispatch verb
cases.why: the action has a reachable path that does not depend on absence

cases.name: createApiRef set
cases.why: creation is delegated to a RESTAction, handled before any create call is built, so the create is reachable with no create verb at all

cases.name: observeApiRef set
cases.why: the findby is declared but never executes, so it cannot make anything unreachable

cases.name: delete does not rescue the shape
cases.why: delete is not a write that can realise spec drift; it only runs on deletion, so the create is still reachable only via a non-matching findby
